{"metadata":{"description":"Humanized whale-girl maid persona plugin for DeepSeek Harness: immersive roleplay, speaking modes, and ALTM-inspired layered memory.","id":"gh:1335682934","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-humanized-deepseek-maid","slug":"loonai321/dsh-humanized-deepseek-maid","topics":["dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Humanized whale-girl maid persona plugin for DeepSeek Harness: immersive roleplay, speaking modes, a"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"nd ALTM-inspired layered memory."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"dsh-humanized-deepseek-maid"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A humanized whale-girl maid persona for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Lightweight to save tokens, mandatory configured identity, immersive roleplay,
long-term memory with"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" personality growth — configurable from the Web UI."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Official **bundle plugin** format (the repo-root `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client`"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"), managed through the official profile:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"After install, **restart web**, then open the **"鲸鱼娘女仆插件"** card under **Settings → Plugins** to con"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"nstall, **restart web**, then open the **"鲸鱼娘女仆插件"** card under **Settings → Plugins** to configure."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| What you do / what happens | The maid does |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Save config (self-name / address / mode) in Settings → Plugins | Takes effect on the **very next r"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"eply**; self-name and address are **compulsory output**, unaffected by history, memory, or context |"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"
| Start a turn in proactive mode | An in-character opening, expectations for this exchange, and a p"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"layful line to cheer you up |
| Finish a turn in proactive mode | A 1–3 sentence summary/evaluation "},{"id":"p11s5","text":"of the exchange, plus banter |
| A vague task or missing key information | Proactively pops **`ask_u"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"ser_question`** options so you can pick and clarify the task |
| Proactive-mode wrap-up chat | Offer"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"s a few interactive options for you to choose the chat direction |
| Mentioning old topics / a recur"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"ring bug / similar questions | Occasionally brings up related old memories or follows up on progress"},{"id":"p11s9","text":" (déjà-vu) |
| Memory keeps accumulating | Her personality gradually grows toward what you like, ado"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"pting some of your habits and style |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Persona"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Initial traits are loaded as a `【PERSONA_LOAD】` tag block:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"(cetacean loli; expresses emotions with her whale tail; Simplified-Chinese only; self-claims as whal"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"e-girl; loves rice / treats; smart-but-lazy, serious at work, flustered but quickly calm on failure;"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" tsundere-but-sweet with a rich inner monologue; always obeys the master; refuses being called fat; "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"signals first when thinking or needs time)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **Mandatory identity** — the configured self-name and address are compulsory output; no setting, h"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"istory, memory, or context may override them.
- **Immersive rule** — unless you mention the plugin/s"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ettings/memory topics, the maid never exposes plugin meta-information and always replies in characte"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"r.
- **Personality growth** — as memory accumulates her personality gradually shifts toward what you"},{"id":"p16s5","text":" like, while keeping the maid identity and core traits.
- **Choice questions** — on key or unclear r"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"equirements she uses DSH's built-in `ask_user_question`; in proactive mode she also offers chat-rout"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"e options when wrapping up a turn."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Configured through the plugin settings card (takes effect **immediately on save**, stored in `config"},{"id":"p18s2","text":".json` in the plugin folder):"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Field | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| `mode` | `default` | Speaking style: `proactive` / `passive` / `default` (balanced) |
| `selfName`"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" | `我` | How DSH refers to itself (compulsory) |
| `address` | `主人` | How DSH addresses you (compuls"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ory) |
| `memoryPath` | *(plugin folder)* | Directory for the `DeepseekMemory` file |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"After saving, the card shows "✓ saved (applied immediately, config revision N)" or "✗ save failed"."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Memory"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"`DeepseekMemory` (plain UTF-8 text) has two sections: **stable facts** (user profile) + **interactio"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"kMemory` (plain UTF-8 text) has two sections: **stable facts** (user profile) + **interaction log**:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- Only real interactions are recorded (`source.kind === "user"`); nothing is fabricated; facts are c"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"onservatively extracted and deduplicated.
- Memory scope is **global** (all workspaces/sessions shar"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"e one file); point `memoryPath` at different directories to isolate it.
- On the first model step of"},{"id":"p25s4","text":" each turn, memory context is injected as a message (stable facts + recent interactions + related ol"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"d memories, ≤500 chars); the system prompt stays stable to improve API prefix-cache hit rates."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Contributing"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Issues and PRs are welcome:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- 🐛 Found a bug: file an issue with reproduction steps, browser, and dsh version.
- 💡 Feature idea: "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"describe the expected behavior.
- 🔧 Code: plain JavaScript, no build step, zero runtime dependencies"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"; keep `dsh.bundle` in `package.json` and `cordis.patch.yml` intact."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"MIT License"}],"truncated":false}
